name: LitBench
intro: LitBench 是首个面向创意写作验证的标准化基准与配套数据集，用于可靠评估 LLM 生成故事的质量偏好判断。它包含去偏的人类标注故事对测试集与大规模训练语料，可用于评测零样本评审模型和训练奖励模型。
build_method: Reddit写作样本收集, 人类偏好标注
task_type: 创意写作质量评估, 成对比较
eval_feature: 零样本LLM评审, 奖励模型训练, 在线人工研究
scale: 测试集2480对, 训练集43827对
intro_en: LitBench is the first standardized benchmark for creative writing verification, pairing a held-out human-labeled comparison test set with a large preference-training corpus.
build_method_en: Collected writing samples from Reddit's r/WritingPrompts and constructed pairwise comparisons with human preference labels
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot LLM Judges, Reward Model Training, Online Human Study

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2507.00769. LitBench collects creative-writing samples from r/WritingPrompts via the Reddit API and uses the pre-2023 MIT-licensed WritingPrompts preference corpus for training. It filters stories by engagement, token length, and minimum word count; forms preference pairs only when upvote gaps are large enough and the higher-upvote story was posted later; mitigates length bias by histogram-based pruning; and independently applies the workflow to the post-2023 held-out benchmark and pre-2023 training data. The final benchmark has 2,480 pairwise comparisons from 3,543 stories and the training set has 43,827 pairwise examples from 50,309 stories, used to evaluate zero-shot LLM judges, Bradley-Terry reward models, generative reward models, and online human validation.
